https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/c93057d4835cd31752bb56f59989dd27696eb45b/src/transformers/audio_utils.py

vibeTerminal implements an independent JavaScript FFT and a port of the documented
Whisper/Slaney frontend equations. NumPy float32 pairwise reduction behavior is
reproduced for normalization parity. Reference fixtures were generated with the
exact library versions recorded in voice-whisper-reference.json.
